g.text: Real 1m DTM: C0 ruled / P1 triangle mixtures on fixed tensor grids
20 fixed source windows; whole-domain E2 and continuous maximum error; actual shared-XYZ GPR4 file bytes.
A / 8192-byte ceiling: selected whole-domain E2 relative to selected P1
B / 0.10 m guarded source-error target: complete file cost
Compared with 135.528 kB full-resolution source ruled bands.

g.text: All 2940 candidates retained. Mixtures minimize local E2 at each grid; split-run metadata counts and can increase complete file cost.
Source-relative continuous bilinear reference, not surveyed ground. Maximum bounds include source-cell corner and triangle-diagonal extrema.
Common tensor edge functions ensure C0, not C1. Fixed finite grids, not paper-style adaptive P1, globally optimal encoding or ArcGIS software.
Independent saved-function integration and native height/gradient/edge checks. Lossy maximum-target simplification is distinct from exact source preservation.
